defaults.permitted_development: Across Surrey, hard surfacing is usually lowest risk on the planning permission route when drainage is handled properly, level changes stay modest and the work does not turn a soft frontage into a dominant engineered parking area. The route is usually strongest where the drainage story, frontage appearance and parking layout all work together rather than being solved separately.

rules.height_rules: Raised surfacing, retaining features and height or level changes can matter as much as the paving finish itself when councils assess hard-surface schemes in Surrey.
rules.depth_rules: Surface coverage, front garden drainage and overall project extent are usually the deciding issues for hard surfacing across Surrey, especially where large impermeable areas are proposed.
rules.boundary_rules: Frontage position, highway relationship and any linked access changes are often what make a hard-surfacing scheme more sensitive in Surrey.
rules.roof_rules: For hard-surface projects, the design equivalent of a roof check is usually the drainage fall and discharge strategy rather than any vertical structure.
rules.materials_rules: Permeable, visually restrained finishes are usually easier to justify than broad impermeable paving that removes planting and dominates the frontage.

rules.permitted_development: The straightforward route for hard surfacing is usually available where the works stay within the curtilage and front areas over 5 square metres are designed so water does not run straight to the highway or sewer.

rules.height_rules: The planning question usually comes from the engineered works that support it, such as retaining walls, terracing, ramps or raised hardstanding.
rules.depth_rules: Front impermeable surfacing without suitable on-site drainage will often need planning permission.
rules.boundary_rules: Separate highway approval is commonly needed for a new or altered vehicular access.
rules.roof_rules: A driveway or paved area does not automatically authorise a roof above it. Once a car port or canopy is added, the structure needs checking under the separate rules for buildings or attached alterations.
rules.materials_rules: Pick materials that help surface water soak away on site. Impermeable paving can still work, but only where the design keeps run-off within the property rather than sending it onto the road.
